answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat block bulk fake identities. A newcomer starts outside the haven of full trust, posts one bond, and begins a 20-epoch voyage. Each epoch the beacon samples 5%; a drawn identity must answer a heartbeat in one hour or lose its bond. Honest agents pay one bond and earn undiluted rewards; an attacker with 100 fakes posts 100 bonds, loses 5 per epoch, and all are gone in 20 epochs, so fraud loses money.
